verdict.rationale: A paper, fax, or mail fallback with published addresses, numbers, and forms is a fair question for a state tax agency, so the axis applies. The evidence pack holds only two probes recording HTTP 403 edge denials at www.ftb.ca.gov/robots.txt and webapp.ftb.ca.gov. Neither says anything about published mailing addresses, fax numbers, or paper forms, so there is no evidence the fallback rail exists.

support.subject: As a founder, a paper, fax, or mail fallback rail is published with the exact addresses, numbers, and forms, so the task can still be completed when the online flow is unavailable
